svg.title: iOS · Projects · holdings pills, PicPlace at work · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/ProjectsView.swift (ProjectCard) + App/HoldingsPill.swift (HoldingsPill, HoldingsPillBody, StatusGlyphView, AppModel.holdingsPillState(for:holdings:)): projects.portrait.svg with the pill in the states PicPlace moves it through. **2026-09-26 (connected asset states, plan §12/§16 — code first, mirrored after Steven's sign-off of the status glyphs):** the 22×18 PicPlace pill this file drew (PicPlacePill over the `picplace-pill` component set — synced green cloud-check, syncing amber arrow, failed orange; nothing on a project never synced) is RETIRED, with PicPlacePill and listState, and its component files are deleted; its seat — the thumbnail's top-right corner, 4pt in, over the picture and the duration badge — is the HOLDINGS PILL's, on every card: components/holdings-pill.<state>.svg, referenced, never redrawn, 18 high, black at 50 %, at x = thumbMaxX − 4 − W, y = thumbMinY + 4 (components/README.md). Left of a hairline, where each thing is — the camera the originals, the layers the blends (only when the project has blends; a Photo's stack is its picture), green here, grey on PicPlace, slashed nowhere reachable; right of it ONE cloud, never green. The retired states map to: SYNCED → ✓ (card 1, both.safe: the video and its two blends here, all verified on PicPlace — here.safe on a project without blends, there.safe on a preview, where the camera greys and the tick stays); SYNCING → amber ↑ (card 2, both.uploading: the originals going up — only a heavy run has an upload stop signal, so a records-only sync draws nothing and the pill stays as it was; here.uploading without blends); FAILED → red ! (card 3, here.attention: a failed sync or upload, a stopped upload job, a conflict — red #FF453A, no longer the old orange beside the amber). NEVER SYNCED no longer means no pill in a connected library: the camera is green and the cloud says ↑ until the originals are up (here.needs, projects.portrait.svg card 3). In a library never connected to PicPlace a project with only its originals here still carries nothing — the list stays as it was for anyone who never signs in — and one with blends carries the green layers alone. The pill is read from the project's holdings (ProjectHoldings, walked off the main actor and cached) and the PicPlace record, progress, jobs and conflicts, never from the index, so the M2 list query is untouched.
